messages:
Evelyn: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we need to finalize owners + minimal ETAs for the KV-cache OOM remediation workstreams: profiling, fragmentation/GC, eviction heuristics, and emergency mitigations. Can we lock these now?

Marcus: I can lead the profiler work (heapshots + allocation timelines). Will produce a short findings doc + repro script. ETA: Wed EOD.

Priya: I'll own fragmentation and GC experiments. Plan: run compaction variants and measure p95/p99 latency impact. ETA: Tue.

Ken: I'll prototype eviction tweaks (size-weighted LRU + soft caps) and add unit tests. ETA: Mon morning.

Zara: I'll do emergency mitigations: emergency-mode flag + circuit-breaker and pager playbook for repeated OOMs. Draft runbook by Mon afternoon.

Evelyn: Please include exact commands for SRE to reproduce and a short validation checklist.

Marcus: Profiling snippet I'll include: `HEAPPROFILE=/tmp/heap ./kvnode --workload=canary && pprof --text /tmp/heap.*` plus a `run-repro.sh` to automate.

Priya: GC draft parameters: `--kv-compact-threshold=0.27 --compact-window=45s` and an incremental compaction toggle. Will report latency delta.

Ken: Eviction scoring idea: score = age + (size_kb/64) + write_penalty. Will test miss-rate under 10k req/s. If bad, fall back to per-prefix hard cap.

Zara: Emergency-mode behavior: mark node read-only if mem > 91% for 60s, emit alert and auto-roll traffic off node. Also adding a manual hotkey to disable writes cluster-wide.

PagerBot: Note: If OOM occurs, create incident with tag #kv-oom and include heap dump link.

Evelyn: Action recap and locked owners:
- Marcus: profiling + repro scripts (Wed EOD)
- Priya: GC/compaction experiments (Tue)
- Ken: eviction heuristics + tests (Mon AM)
- Zara: emergency-mode + pager playbook (Mon PM)
- Evelyn: update postmortem board + schedule 30m check-in Friday 09:00

Marcus: Sharing initial heapshots to the postmortem doc now.

Ken: Starting eviction prototype against Marcus's repro script.

Priya: Posting benchmark harness and expected metrics to the board (50/95/99 latencies, fragmentation ratio).

Zara: Draft runbook up in the board card; will sync with Support for tenant comms templates.

Evelyn: One more pattern we noted in the postmortem: recurring small OOM spikes clustered during heavy prefix churn. If anyone sees a different pattern in their runs, update the board card.

Marcus: Saw exactly that in heapshots: repeated small allocs that never freed due to reference cycles in cache layer. I'll highlight stack traces.

Ken: If reference cycles are present, eviction won't help much. Will add a defensive free-on-evict path and test.

Priya: If fragmentation remains high after compaction, I'll propose a background compact-on-idle pass.

Evelyn: Locking owners and creating the calendar invite. Please keep the postmortem card updated; we'll triage slips weekly.

PagerBot: Calendar event created: "KV-cache OOM remediation sync" Fri 09:00.
